Two vertical chains and overhead linked pulley gear clearly link the opposing platforms. Winch handle and small brake lever are at the upper landing OUTSIDE the shaft, reachable from courtyard. revision_notes.instruction: Preserve the original map; connect one cutaway pedestrian culvert from the trough directly to the surface loading courtyard; remove the redundant arch and unused road behind the ridge. Keep the broad cart road around the ridge.

Preserve both existing suspended wooden platforms at their original illustrated heights. Replace ballast with exactly four separate blocks labelled 1, 2, 4, 8 on the upper wooden platform; put 6 on the lower chest; add skids. No ballast on the courtyard floor.

map_conventions: Key circles are added by the PDF layout. Stated distances govern play. The cutaway deliberately exposes the upper platform suspension; its loading stop is level with the landing in play.
